data.name: Genius.fun
data.description: A permissionless token launchpad on BNB Smart Chain with bonding-curve trading, multiple quote assets, creator fee distributions, and graduation into permanently locked PancakeSwap Infinity liquidity

methodology.Fees: Token creation, bonding-curve trading (including any launch-window surcharge), Genius hook trading and paid Alpha promotion fees. Fees accrue at launch/trade/promotion; settlements are excluded. Meme-denominated hook fees use the same swap’s quote/meme execution-price ratio, rounded down to quote base units.
methodology.Revenue: The Genius platform share of trading fees under each launch’s immutable policy, plus separately labeled creation and Alpha promotion fees. The creator-selected destination allocation (Foundation or creator), creator share and launched-meme buyback allocations are excluded.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The same protocol-retained portion as Revenue. Genius.fun has no protocol token receiving these fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Creator-selected destination allocations (Foundation or creator), creator shares and accrued funding for buybacks of individual launched meme tokens, calculated from immutable per-launch policies with contract integer rounding.

Fees.Curve Trading Fees: CurveBuy and CurveSell fee + tax; CurveBuy.fee already contains any snipe surcharge.
Fees.Hook Trading Fees: HookFeeCollected feeAmount + taxAmount, valued in the pool’s paired quote asset at the originating trade’s execution price when needed.
Fees.Token Creation Fees: One historical factory launchFee per TokenLaunched, replaying same-period fee changes in log order.
Fees.Alpha Promotion Fees: Actual BNB paid in AlphaPromoted events, including zero-cost grants.

Revenue.Curve Fees To Genius: The platform share of bonding-curve fees under each launch’s immutable fee policy.
Revenue.Hook Fees To Genius: The platform share of accrued Genius hook fees; meme-denominated fees are valued at the originating swap’s execution price.
Revenue.Token Creation Fees To Genius: Token creation fees retained by Genius, using the historical factory fee and intraperiod LaunchFeeUpdated events.
Revenue.Alpha Promotion Fees To Genius: Actual paidWei in AlphaPromoted events; free grants contribute zero.

ProtocolRevenue.Curve Fees To Genius: The platform share of bonding-curve fees under each launch’s immutable fee policy.
ProtocolRevenue.Hook Fees To Genius: The platform share of accrued Genius hook fees; meme-denominated fees are valued at the originating swap’s execution price.
ProtocolRevenue.Token Creation Fees To Genius: Token creation fees retained by Genius, using the historical factory fee and intraperiod LaunchFeeUpdated events.
ProtocolRevenue.Alpha Promotion Fees To Genius: Actual paidWei in AlphaPromoted events; free grants contribute zero.

SupplySideRevenue.Curve Fees To Foundation: Creator-selected destination allocation from curve fees routed to the shared Foundation vault; excluded from Genius platform revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Hook Fees To Foundation: Creator-selected destination allocation from hook fees routed to the shared Foundation vault; excluded from Genius platform revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Curve Fees To Creators: Creator share, any destination share selected for the creator, and separate creator tax on curve trades.
SupplySideRevenue.Curve Fees For Meme Buybacks: Accrued curve-fee allocation reserved to buy back and burn that launch’s meme token.

data.name: Argus World
data.description: Tax-token launchpad on Arc. Each launch mints its whole supply into a single-sided Uniswap v4 position held by a locker with no withdrawal path, so there is no bonding curve and no migration — the token trades in a real v4 pool from block one, and a per-launch hook charges a buy/sell tax on every swap.

methodology.Fees: The tax ArgusPad's per-launch hook charges on every buy and sell, the trading fee each launch's pool charges (on Portals 3-7 the 1% pool fee earned by the permanently locked launch position; on Portal 8 a 1% base fee the hook charges in the quote asset in its place), and the extra tax charged on buys in a launch's first seconds. Counted in the asset the fee is charged in, at the moment it is charged, so the protocol's later sale of the launched tokens it was paid is not counted a second time. Fees charged in the launched token itself (Portals 3-7 only; Portal 8 takes every fee in the quote asset) are reported in that token's own units and are priced only if DefiLlama has a price for it; it has none for these tokens today, because a launched token's only market is the pool ArgusPad seeded, and pricing it there overstates by about 40% against what ArgusPad's own sales of them actually realise.
methodology.Revenue: The share of fees reaching the ArgusPad treasury at the rate each launch fixes at creation - 10% of every fee on Portals 3-7 and 30% on Portal 8 - plus the whole of the early-buy snipe tax, which is paid straight to the treasury.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The share of fees reaching the ArgusPad treasury at the rate each launch fixes at creation - 10% of every fee on Portals 3-7 and 30% on Portal 8 - plus the whole of the early-buy snipe tax, which is paid straight to the treasury.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The rest of the fees, which leave the protocol divided at the weights each launch fixed at creation: the token creator's share, the dividends paid to holders of that launched token, the share added back into the launch's permanently locked liquidity, the share used to buy and burn the launched token, and on Portal 8 the share used to buy the launched token and lock it permanently.

Fees.Swap Tax: The launch's own buy and sell tax, chosen per launch (1-10%), taken by its hook on each swap: on Portals 3-7 read from that swap's TaxTaken, net of the tax the splitter pays itself when it sells launched tokens through the launch's own pool, which is not paid by any user; on Portal 8 the tax part of QuoteFeeTaken's bucketFee. The hook charges it outside the pool fee, so it is not inside Uniswap's fee reporting for Arc.
Fees.LP Fees: Portals 3-7: the 1% Uniswap v4 pool fee earned by the launch's permanently locked position, read as what the locker forwarded to the splitter, net of the position principal that comes back through the same call. These fees are also inside Uniswap's fee reporting for Arc.
Fees.Token Swap Fees: Portal 8: the 1% base fee the hook adds to every buy and sell and takes in the quote asset. Portal 8 pools are dynamic-fee pools whose pool fee is set to zero on every swap, so this replaces the LP fee and goes to the same split; it is not inside Uniswap's fee reporting for Arc. It is the base's proportional part of QuoteFeeTaken's bucketFee, which prices tax and base as one rate.
Fees.Snipe Tax: An extra, time-decaying tax on buys in the seconds after a launch opens, charged by the same hook and paid directly to the treasury (Portal 8: QuoteFeeTaken's surcharge).

Revenue.Swap Fees to Treasury: treasuryBps of each launch's accrued fee, read from that launch's own splitter or escrow (1000 on every Portal 3-7 launch, 3000 on every Portal 8 launch), plus the whole snipe tax, which the hook pays straight to the treasury without passing through a splitter, plus on Portal 8 any holders' share accrued while no holder was eligible, which the hook also pays straight to the treasury.

ProtocolRevenue.Swap Fees to Treasury: treasuryBps of each launch's accrued fee, read from that launch's own splitter or escrow (1000 on every Portal 3-7 launch, 3000 on every Portal 8 launch), plus the whole snipe tax, which the hook pays straight to the treasury without passing through a splitter, plus on Portal 8 any holders' share accrued while no holder was eligible, which the hook also pays straight to the treasury.

SupplySideRevenue.Creator Fees: The token creator's share, at that launch's configured creatorBps, credited to the creator to claim. Takes the remainder of the supply side, so fees equal revenue plus supply-side revenue exactly.
SupplySideRevenue.Launched Token Holder Dividends: Dividends paid out to holders of the launched token, at that launch's configured dividendBps. These are not ARGUS holders, so they are a supply-side cost rather than holders revenue.
SupplySideRevenue.Fees Compounded Into Locked Liquidity: The share added straight back into the launch's permanently locked position instead of being paid to anyone, at that launch's configured liquidityBps.
SupplySideRevenue.Launched Token Buy and Burn: The share used to buy and burn the launched token, at that launch's configured burnBps. It buys the launched token, not ARGUS, so it is a cost carried by that launch's supply side rather than a protocol buyback or a payment to holders.
SupplySideRevenue.Launched Token Buy and Lock: Portal 8: the share used to buy the launched token and lock it permanently in the line's lock vault, at that launch's configured lockBps. Like the burn it buys the launched token, not ARGUS, so it is supply side.
